purpose: Navigate an explicitly supplied set of result-page destinations while identifying the current page.
avoid: Do not invent total counts when the backend cannot provide them.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: Root nav role=navigation is named pagination; Content/Item are ul/li. PaginationLink renders Button as anchor with nativeButton=false; isActive sets aria-current=page and outline instead of ghost, size defaults icon. Previous/Next default text and accessible English labels can be overridden for localization. Ellipsis is aria-hidden. The wrapper does not calculate page count, clamp indices, fetch results or implement a disabled prop on PaginationLink. Selected Base UI1.9 Button nativeButton=false supplies role=button and tabindex=0 on the source href anchor. Space activates on keyup; Enter uses native link activation. Modified pointer clicks still carry native href/modifiers. There is no roving arrow selection or automatic page state.

referenceDecision: Concrete labels, destination fragments and validation text are caller-supplied examples. The bound source wrapper does not automatically supply those application decisions.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Pagination binds all seven actual exports and explicitly imports its real Button styling dependency. Native 32px square page actions and 2px gap are retained; destination wording does not become fixed previous/next widths. The selected pinned Button primitive renders these anchors with role=button and tabindex=0 because nativeButton=false, and intentionally supplies Space activation while Enter uses native href activation. The reference faithfully describes page actions backed by href, rather than incorrectly claiming plain link roles or Enter-only behavior. isActive supplies aria-current=page, data-active and the source outline variant; it does not change a stored page index. Previous/Next text and accessible names are caller-localizable; the reference follows the source hide/show text recipe at explicit 40rem. Unavailable boundary actions are omitted, not fake-disabled anchors. Ellipsis remains hidden and does not imply a menu. All page computation, routing/fetching and isActive updates remain caller-owned.
